messages:
liam: FYI Acme Health just paged — their private deploy showed token-level latency jumps and Grafana token-stage panels went empty around 09:10-09:40 UTC. Prom sidecar logs show repeated timeouts.

devon: Can you paste the exporter logs? :eyes:

liam: redacted logs:
```
2026-03-12T09:11:03Z level=error component=exporter msg="write /metrics failed" err="i/o timeout"
2026-03-12T09:11:04Z level=warn component=exporter msg="backpressure: queue full"
```

maya: Reproduced on staging private image. When KV cache eviction rate spikes (lots of cold sessions), inference threads do synchronous mmap reads and cpu scheduling pushes exporter into starvation. Also saw a perf sample where kernel_selector chose scalar matmul for seq_len>1024 -> compute cost per token skyrockets.

isabel: Scalar fallback? I thought selector guarded for ISA/features. Do we have any runtime selection logs?

maya: We didn't log it previously. Quick probe added shows mismatch: 
``
runtime_kernel_choice{model="rwkv-13b",device="gpu0"} "avx_fp16"
runtime_kernel_choice{model="rwkv-13b",device="gpu1"} "scalar"
```
One device flipped to generic path after NVML timed out.

devon: So two compounding issues: kernel fallback -> much slower matmul; and KV misses causing IO blocking -> exporter can't flush -> panels blank. That explains token p95 breaches.

raj-cs: Customer saw rounded-sla breaches (per-route p95). They flagged on the dashboard and want mitigation before Monday.

liam: Short-term action items: (1) make exporter resilient to transient backpressure, (2) add token-stage metrics so dashboards keep showing partial data, (3) patch kernel_selector race that yields scalar fallback.

isabel: Proposed metric names for private dashboards:
- token_latency_seconds_bucket{stage="enqueue|kv_lookup|compute|decode"}
- token_queue_wait_ms
- kv_cache_hit_ratio
- runtime_kernel_choice
- effective_batch_size_histogram

maya: Example PromQL to get p95 by stage:
``
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/.*"}[1m])) by (le,stage,route))
```

devon: For air-gapped customers: Acme has Prometheus scraping the sidecar locally; when the writer blocks the scrape times out. Short-term patch: change exporter to write to a local rotating file (append-only) with a bounded queue and non-blocking flush. Ops can scp the file off or we provide a tiny pull utility.

isabel: Long-term roadmap for private sidecar: buffered push-mode supporting (a) TLS to customer push endpoint, (b) local disk buffer with configurable retention + encryption, (c) optional S3/MinIO sink connector for offline sync. I'll sketch API and config flags.

maya: Runtime protections: exporter should run at lower scheduling priority and snapshot in-memory aggregators so it never blocks workers. Also we should make KV lookups async (io threads) for mmap/backing-store reads so inference threads aren't stuck.

liam: Add per-route KPIs to default private dashboard: token p50/p95/p99 by stage, kv_hit_ratio, effective_batch_size, kernel_choice heatmap.

devon: Opening perf/regression ticket with flamegraph attached. Flamegraph shows ~62% time in "scalar_matmul" and ~18% syscalls waiting for kv-backed IO. Ticket: PERF-3712 (private-deploy exporter+kernel-fallback).

raj-cs: Customer asked for alerting: (A) exporter scrape_failures > 5 in 5m; (B) token_stage_p95 > 2x baseline for any route. Can we get templated alerts?

isabel: Yes. I'll add templated alert rules and a Grafana dashboard PR. I'll own sidecar design + panels.

maya: I'll work on kernel_selector fix and prototype async KV lookup. Devon, can you do exporter nonblocking snapshot + file buffer?

devon: On it. Draft PR by EOD with --export-mode=buffered that falls back to rotating file and nonblocking writes.

liam: Assigning: isabel -> sidecar & dashboards; maya -> kernel selector + async-kv; devon -> exporter snapshot & disk buffer. I'll notify Acme ops and schedule Monday follow-up. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-12-ACME-PROM-SCRAPE. Owners: isabel, maya, devon. Follow-up meeting: 2026-03-15T15:00:00Z.
